sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test setup
sections.what: Imports the test runner, the room functions and the list of sports.
sections.why: Provides what the room tests need.

sections.name: event rooms (rooms)
sections.title: Event room checks
sections.what: Checks each sport either has event rooms or a pending reason that mentions the missing source, with basketball and tennis having none. Checks a cricket room has a named match, a win-probability trace with values between zero and one, a leverage value with a time, stories, and a receipt from the cricket source. Checks rain-affected cricket, football and F1 rooms show a missing model message with no numbers, and that unknown events return nothing.
sections.why: Likely reason: the rooms should be useful where data exists and clearly honest where it does not.
sections.watch_out: Fixed expectations such as the seven cricket events and the story count will change when fixtures change.

summary: Tests the event room lists: which sports and events have rooms, what each cricket room shows, and that missing data is labelled as missing rather than shown as numbers.
purpose: Makes sure event rooms show real data where it exists and an honest reason where it does not.
why: Likely reason: users should not see made-up win probabilities for matches where the model or the source is missing.
how: Checks every sport has either event rooms or a pending reason. Then checks one cricket room has the expected trace, leverage, stories and receipts, and that rain-affected cricket, football and F1 rooms say the model is missing.
inputs: Sports list and event identifiers that refer to recorded fixture data.
outputs: Pass or fail results. The rooms themselves are not changed.
risks: The count of seven cricket events is fixed in the test, so adding fixtures changes it. Missing model text must stay visible.
debug: Check which event identifier failed and whether its fixture file exists. Check the sport list for new sports.
